summary: Iteration 3 retest: regression fix for /api/assessment-narrative hotline-leak is fully verified. All 25 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_kompas_backend.py pass (incl. TestNarrative::test_narrative_crisis_does_not_mention_1813). Additional consistency suite test_narrative_scrub_consistency.py (3x crisis_flag=true at PHQ-9 27/27 + 1 low-score control) also passes 4/4. The 3-layer fix in server.py works: (1) crisis_flag no longer forwarded to LLM, (2) NARRATIVE_SYSTEM_PROMPT has explicit forbidden-words list, (3) _scrub_hotline_refs regex strips any sentence still containing 1813/1712/113/112/zelfmoordlijn/hulplijn/noodlijn/tele-onthaal/spoed. Low-score narrative (PHQ-9 3/27 Mild crisis_flag=false) still returns ~150 words and ends with 'Dit is een indicatie, geen diagnose.' Crisis-score narrative remains substantive (~156 words) and empathetic without any hotline references.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: 3-layer defense (prompt + forbidden-words list + regex scrubber) is the right belt-and-suspenders pattern for negative LLM constraints — recommend keeping this approach for any future never-emit tokens.
Consider removing the now-unused crisis_flag field from NarrativeRequest entirely (still accepted but no longer forwarded). Currently harmless but creates a dead input contract surface.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_narrative_scrub_consistency.py (new — parametrised 3x crisis-call consistency + low-score sanity, 4 tests, all pass)
seed_data_creation: Test run added ~3 conversations and 1 TEST_ assessment-result to kompas_db (same pattern as iteration 2).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Admin token 'kompas-admin-dev-2026' via X-Admin-Token header. /api/assessment-narrative is now hardened against hotline leaks at 3 layers; if you add new forbidden tokens, update both NARRATIVE_SYSTEM_PROMPT (line ~84) AND the _HOTLINE_PATTERNS regex list (line ~385) in server.py — both layers must agree. Frontend was not retouched this iteration; the previously-flagged dead comment 'Crisis-hulplijn: 1813' in /app/frontend/src/data/assessments.ts line 2 (code comment only, not user-visible) is still present but does not affect output.
rca_of_issue: Original bug (iter 2): the LLM was being told to skip hulplijnen in the system prompt while simultaneously being told 'Crisis-flag actief: JA' in the user prompt — conflicting signals which Claude 4.5 resolved by emitting safety language. Fix verified now: crisis_flag is dropped from the user prompt entirely, the system prompt enumerates the exact forbidden tokens, and a deterministic regex post-filter (_scrub_hotline_refs) acts as a final guard, dropping any sentence that still matches the forbidden pattern. 3 consecutive crisis calls at PHQ-9 27/27 all came back clean.
